import Mathlib

def total_weight (selected : List Bool) (weights : List Nat) : Nat :=
  match selected, weights with
  | [], _ => 0
  | _, [] => 0
  | b :: bs, w :: ws => (if b then w else 0) + total_weight bs ws

def total_value (selected : List Bool) (values : List Nat) : Nat :=
  match selected, values with
  | [], _ => 0
  | _, [] => 0
  | b :: bs, v :: vs => (if b then v else 0) + total_value bs vs

def is_valid_strategy (selected : List Bool) (weights : List Nat) (capacity : Nat) : Prop :=
  selected.length = weights.length ∧
  total_weight selected weights ≤ capacity

-- Precondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def knapsack_01_precond (weights values : List Nat) (capacity : Nat) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start precond
  weights.length = values.length
  -- !benchmark @end precond

-- !benchmark @start auxcode
def knap : List Nat → List Nat → Nat → Nat
  | [], _, _ => 0
  | _ :: _, [], _ => 0
  | w :: ws, v :: vs, cap =>
      max (knap ws vs cap) (if w ≤ cap then v + knap ws vs (cap - w) else 0)
-- !benchmark @end auxcode

-- Main function definition
def knapsack_01 (weights values : List Nat) (capacity : Nat)
    (h_precond : knapsack_01_precond weights values capacity) : Nat :=
  -- !benchmark @start code
  knap weights values capacity
  -- !benchmark @end code

-- Postcondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def knapsack_01_postcond (weights values : List Nat) (capacity : Nat) (result : Nat)
    (_ : knapsack_01_precond weights values capacity) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start postcond
  (∀ selected, is_valid_strategy selected weights capacity → total_value selected values ≤ result) ∧
  (∃ selected, is_valid_strategy selected weights capacity ∧ total_value selected values = result)
  -- !benchmark @end postcond

-- !benchmark @start lemma
lemma knap_nil (vs : List Nat) (cap : Nat) : knap [] vs cap = 0 := by
  simp [knap]

lemma knap_cons (w : Nat) (ws : List Nat) (v : Nat) (vs : List Nat) (cap : Nat) :
    knap (w :: ws) (v :: vs) cap =
      max (knap ws vs cap) (if w ≤ cap then v + knap ws vs (cap - w) else 0) := by
  simp only [knap]

lemma tw_nil (ws : List Nat) : total_weight [] ws = 0 := by
  simp [total_weight]

lemma tv_nil (vs : List Nat) : total_value [] vs = 0 := by
  simp [total_value]

lemma tw_true (bs : List Bool) (w : Nat) (ws : List Nat) :
    total_weight (true :: bs) (w :: ws) = w + total_weight bs ws := by
  simp [total_weight]

lemma tw_false (bs : List Bool) (w : Nat) (ws : List Nat) :
    total_weight (false :: bs) (w :: ws) = total_weight bs ws := by
  simp [total_weight]

lemma tv_true (bs : List Bool) (v : Nat) (vs : List Nat) :
    total_value (true :: bs) (v :: vs) = v + total_value bs vs := by
  simp [total_value]

lemma tv_false (bs : List Bool) (v : Nat) (vs : List Nat) :
    total_value (false :: bs) (v :: vs) = total_value bs vs := by
  simp [total_value]

theorem knap_upper : ∀ (ws vs : List Nat) (cap : Nat) (sel : List Bool),
    sel.length = ws.length → ws.length = vs.length →
    total_weight sel ws ≤ cap → total_value sel vs ≤ knap ws vs cap := by
  intro ws
  induction ws with
  | nil =>
    intro vs cap sel h1 h2 h3
    cases sel with
    | nil => simp [tv_nil, knap_nil]
    | cons b bs => simp at h1
  | cons w ws ih =>
    intro vs cap sel h1 h2 h3
    cases vs with
    | nil => simp at h2
    | cons v vs =>

      | nil => simp at h1
      | cons b bs =>
        have hl1 : bs.length = ws.length := by simpa using h1
        have hl2 : ws.length = vs.length := by simpa using h2

          rw [tv_true]

        | false =>
          rw [tw_false] at h3
          rw [tv_false]
          exact le_trans (ih vs cap bs hl1 hl2 h3) (le_max_left _ _)

theorem knap_exists : ∀ (ws vs : List Nat) (cap : Nat), ws.length = vs.length →
    ∃ sel : List Bool, sel.length = ws.length ∧ total_weight sel ws ≤ cap ∧
      total_value sel vs = knap ws vs cap := by

  induction ws with
  | nil =>
    intro vs cap _
    exact ⟨[], rfl, by rw [tw_nil]; exact Nat.zero_le _, by simp [tv_nil, knap_nil]⟩
  | cons w ws ih =>

    cases vs with
    | nil => simp at h
    | cons v vs =>
      have hl : ws.length = vs.length := by simpa using h
      obtain ⟨s1, hs1l, hs1w, hs1v⟩ := ih vs cap hl
      rw [knap_cons]
      by_cases hw : w ≤ cap

          · rw [tw_false]; exact hs1w

        · rw [max_eq_right hle]

          · rw [tw_true]; omega

        · rw [tv_false]; exact hs1v

    (h_precond : knapsack_01_precond weights values capacity) :
    knapsack_01_postcond weights values capacity (knapsack_01 weights values capacity h_precond) h_precond := by
  -- !benchmark @start proof
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · intro sel hsel
    simp only [is_valid_strategy] at hsel
    obtain ⟨hlen, hwt⟩ := hsel
    exact knap_upper weights values capacity sel hlen h_precond hwt
  · obtain ⟨sel, h1, h2, h3⟩ := knap_exists weights values capacity h_precond
    exact ⟨sel, ⟨h1, h2⟩, h3⟩
  -- !benchmark @end proof
